bifrost: springboard/src/shell/screentime/ (usage.rs, config.rs, shield.rs, page.rs, chart.rs), springboard/src/shell/settings.rs; no SDK module
summary: Apple's framework is a parent-controls API for web-usage reporting, web-history deletion and child-restriction queries, and it does nothing on visionOS. BifrOSt has no web-usage reporting and no web-history deletion API. Its shell has a Screen Time feature (per-app usage, daily app limits, Downtime, a Time Limit shield) that is not exposed to apps through any SDK API.

features.apple: STWebpageController: url, urlIsBlocked, urlIsPlayingVideo, urlIsPictureInPicture, suppressUsageRecording, setBundleIdentifier(_:), profileIdentifier
features.note: Wave 4 (theme-23, parity/integration 0925691e): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. The browser keeps visits for its own History menu. Nothing reports web usage to a Screen Time store, and no block check for URLs exists.

Wave 5 (w5-screen-time, parity/integration 93f283b0): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. The shell reads its own configuration. Apps get no observer and no child-restrictions query.

features.apple: STWebHistory: init(bundleIdentifier:), init(profileIdentifier:), deleteAllHistory(), deleteHistory(during:), deleteHistory(for:), fetchAllHistory(completionHandler:), fetchHistory(during:completionHandler:)
features.note: Wave 4 (w4-screen-time, parity/integration 0925691e): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. No API lets an app or a parent delete or fetch another app's web history by bundle identifier or date range.

features.apple: Not an Apple API; the Screen Time app's usage data (no public API in this framework)
features.bifrost: springboard/src/shell/screentime/usage.rs (Tracker, one key=value day file per day, 7-day chart history)
features.note: Foreground seconds per app and per hour, pickups and notifications per app. Read only by Settings, not by apps.

features.feature: Daily app limits and the Time Limit shield
features.apple: Not in this framework (system Screen Time)
features.note: Limits from 15 min to 4 h, a full-screen shield with OK and Ignore Limit for 15 min or the rest of the day, behind the Screen Time passcode when one is set. Settings is never shielded.

features.apple: Not in this framework (system Screen Time)
features.note: A daily window that may cross midnight. During Downtime only the apps the user always allows can run.

features.bifrost: springboard/src/shell/screentime/page.rs, springboard/src/shell/screentime/chart.rs, springboard/src/shell/settings.rs (st_spec and the Screen Time handlers)
features.note: Settings has Screen Time, Downtime, App Limits and Always Allowed pages with a weekly chart. Web usage is not charted, and there is no Content Restrictions page.

gaps: Web-usage reporting: no equivalent of STWebpageController to report visited URLs, playing video or picture-in-picture, or to ask whether a URL is blocked.
Web-history API: no equivalent of STWebHistory to fetch or delete browsing history by bundle identifier, profile or date range.
Configuration query: apps cannot observe the device Screen Time configuration or ask whether child restrictions are enforced.
Web-usage data in the Settings chart and no URL block list, so the shield covers apps only.
No SDK module exposes the shell's Screen Time usage or limit state to apps; none is documented in docs/bifrost-ui.md.
